description: Design Proof — the independent design layer for coding agents. Every AI-built UI has a tell: capture the page, name the tells with deterministic detectors, art-direct the fix, and draft the patch. Eleven tell_* MCP tools plus design skills.

defaultPrompt: Run tell_diagnose on http://localhost:3001 and draft an editorial redesign.
Design a dashboard from these features with tell_design_from_features.
interface.longDescription: Design Proof sits beside your coding agent as an independent design critic and craft engine. It captures a rendered page with Playwright, names its design tells with deterministic detectors, art-directs a direction in plain words, and drafts a source-ranked patch your agent can apply and re-verify. The plugin bundles the repo's design skills with the local stdio MCP server (the same server Cursor uses). It runs the monorepo from this checkout, so clone the repo and install it first (pnpm install). ChatGPT cannot run local stdio servers; in ChatGPT this plugin needs a hosted HTTPS MCP endpoint, which is a later step. This package targets Codex on desktop and CLI.
interface.shortDescription: Capture, diagnose and art-direct AI-built UI with eleven tell_* tools.

name: designproof
